title: Moderately beyond clique-width: reduced component max-leaf and related parameters
summary: Reduced parameters [BKW, JCTB '26; BKRT, SODA '22] are defined via contraction sequences. Based on this framework, we introduce the reduced component max-leaf, denoted by $\operatorname{cml}^\downarrow$, where component max-leaf is the maximum number of leaves in any spanning tree of any connected component. Reduced component max-leaf is strictly sandwiched between clique-width and reduced bandwidth, it is bounded in unit interval graphs, and unbounded in planar graphs.
